label: Normal week
description: Baseline demand and staffing from the catalog, no special events. Random call-outs and equipment failures at their catalog rates.

label: Flu surge
description: A respiratory-illness wave starts on day 2. Arrivals rise, the respiratory share grows and staff call out more often (parameters in catalog/event.yaml, flu_wave).

label: Nursing absences
description: A week of elevated nurse call-outs starting on day 1 (catalog/event.yaml, staff_callouts). Fewer nurses means fewer staffed bays.

label: Imaging outage
description: One CT scanner goes down on day 1 at 08:00 (catalog/event.yaml, equipment_outage). Patients needing CT queue for the remaining scanner.

label: Discharge delays
description: Inpatient stays run longer from day 1 (catalog/event.yaml, discharge_delay). Ward beds free up more slowly, so admitted patients board in ED bays.

label: M/M/c validation
description: Everything stripped to a plain multi-server queue - Poisson arrivals at a flat rate, one station with c servers, exponential service, no abandonment. Used by the tests to compare the simulated mean wait with the Erlang-C result.
